title: GEN ($$$): May 2027 $37 calls bought
summary: 3,500 May 2027 $37 calls bought at $1.80 on 11/24, adding to an unusual 4,000 April 2027 $35 calls bought at $1.55 on 11/18 (open interest 6,831 at that strike); spot $30.00. Shares are up about 10% YTD and have held above the 50-day and 21-day EMA for 19 straight sessions, 5.4% under the September high. Valuation sits near the low end of its 10-year range into a raised outlook; a close through the September high is the breakout trigger.

title: ICE ($$): Jan 2029 $130 calls bought
summary: A stock-replacement buyer took 375 January 2029 $130 in-the-money calls at $62.08 (about $2.3M), plus 275 January 2029 $150 calls at $48.41 on 11/24; spot $174.90. Shares have closed above the 50-day every session since 10/29 and sit 3.6% under the 11/12 high near $181, with the 21-day EMA near $171 as first support. Desk lean is the long-dated call as a stock substitute; $$ Featured, not the $$$ list.

title: Desk market wrap 11/24
summary: Stocks faded as the Nvidia relief rally lost momentum and a report of new tariffs on China and the EU weighed; semis were hit hard as money rotated out of AI, while biotech, pharma and retail led. Breadth improved into the afternoon with IWM and the Dow turning green. S&P resistance 7,330 / 7,500, support 6,970 / 6,830. GDP, PCE and durable goods are due before the holiday. Size puts sold in MU, TSM, AMD, ADI; calls bought in CCCC, MRNA, BMRN.
